defects.cause: it calls createTestValues with an argument that method does not take, which raises inside its try, so the answer is always 0 (checked on x + 1 and x + y)

defects.symptom: Raises error R24 today instead of returning a rank correlation.
defects.cause: known defect: the body reads a variable named _oOtherStats_ that this method does not receive

defects.symptom: Returns the mutual information, in bits, between this data and another data set of the same length.
defects.cause: known defect: the pairs are joined with an underscore and split again, so a value containing an underscore gives a wrong result: "a_b" and "c_d" against x and y give 0 where ab and cd give 1

defects.symptom: Raises error R5 today instead of returning a text preview of a plan's steps without running it.
defects.cause: known defect: the body reads the title from a variable named oPlan, which does not exist, instead of from the plan it built

defects.symptom: Raises error today instead of solving by branch and bound, which is not implemented yet.
defects.cause: an honesty guard stops the method on its first line, so the branching code after it never runs; use "greedy" or "simplex"

defects.symptom: Raises error R5 today instead of returning the objective value less the constraint penalty, negated when minimizing.
defects.cause: it raises whenever the problem has a constraint, because CalculatePenalty fails (two problems); with no constraint it returns the objective value, negated when minimizing

defects.symptom: Raises error R5 today instead of returning 1000 times the total constraint violation of a candidate.
defects.cause: line 995 reads a variable oConst that is never defined, ahead of the correct line; it raises with one constraint and with two, and returns 0 when the problem has none

defects.symptom: Answers FALSE today: the currency symbol check is a stub that waits for the locale data.

defects.cause: answers FALSE for aab and for xxyy alike: it compares two engine handles, which are never equal, instead of the two characters; the stzString method of the same name answers 1 for aab

defects.symptom: Returns 0 today whatever the text is, instead of telling whether the text ends with a repeated character.
defects.cause: answers FALSE for abb and for xxyy alike: it compares two engine handles, which are never equal, instead of the two characters

defects.symptom: Returns 0 today whatever the text is, because both of the questions it combines answer 0.

defects.symptom: Raises an error today instead of counting a fragment inside a section of the text.

defects.symptom: Returns the text with the later occurrences of a substring removed, leaving the helper unchanged.
defects.cause: the same overlap defect

defects.symptom: Raises the error "Clipboard access is not supported in this environment!" today.

defects.symptom: Raises error R13 today instead of inserting a fragment in front of each of several positions.
defects.cause: raises Object is required (R13) for every valid list of numbers: [1,3,5] on banana; probable cause the line that sorts the positions with new stzList(panPos).SortedInDescending(); an empty or non-numeric list raises Incorrect param type instead

defects.symptom: Sorts the strings in place by a numeric key computed from each one, such as its length; a text key raises.
defects.cause: known defect: @item is not defined here and raises R24, and a key that is text raises R41 because keys are compared with a greater-than, so only numeric keys such as len(@string) work

defects.symptom: TRUE if every string matches the pattern as a whole, so "a." matches ab and "a" does not; an empty list is TRUE.
defects.cause: known defect: the old comment says it returns the strings that match, but it answers one verdict for the whole list

defects.symptom: Returns the text the performer holds, which no method of this class changes today.
Leaves the text unchanged today instead of replacing every character by the result of an expression.
defects.cause: Has no effect today: Perform("upper(@char)") on "abc" leaves "abc", because the result of the engine call is dropped and never written back; use Yield to get the results as a list

defects.symptom: Leaves the text unchanged today instead of replacing the characters at some positions by the result of an expression.
defects.cause: Has no effect today: PerformOn([1], "upper(@char)") on "abc" leaves "abc"; the positions are not even read; use YieldOn

defects.symptom: Leaves the text unchanged today, because the occurrence it aims at is one past the last, in place.
defects.cause: it asks the nth removal for a rank equal to the number of occurrences, and that rank counts from 0 in the default case-sensitive call, so nothing is removed: one two one two one, aaa bbb and its b stay as they are; RemoveLastCS(..., 0) does remove the last occurrence

defects.symptom: Returns only the text before the first separator, in a one-item list, today instead of the cut into before, separator and after.
defects.cause: the engine hands back the three pieces in a buffer separated by NUL bytes and Ring reads only up to the first one, so key=value=more with = gives only key; confirmed with a-b, x=y=z, one two and a Hebrew text; stzString.Partition gives the real three-part cut

defects.symptom: Returns only the text behind the first separator, in a one-item list, today instead of the cut that keeps the separator on the first part.
defects.cause: the NUL-separated engine buffer is read up to its first NUL, so key=value=more with = gives only value=more; confirmed with a-b, x=y=z and a Hebrew text

defects.symptom: Returns only the text before the last separator, in a one-item list, today instead of the cut into before, separator and after.
defects.cause: the NUL-separated engine buffer is read up to its first NUL, so key=value=more with = gives key=value; confirmed with x=y=z

defects.symptom: Returns only the text behind the last separator, in a one-item list, today instead of the cut that keeps the separator on the first part.
defects.cause: the NUL-separated engine buffer is read up to its first NUL, so key=value=more with = gives only more; confirmed with x=y=z and a Hebrew text
